items.text: Fish Audio Drama 3 as an online engine (your own key) and as a local one: directed in plain words, several speakers in one scene, 80+ languages.
Books in any of 80+ languages: the book language menu lists every language the chosen engine reads; the voice sample language menu does too.
Several voices: a local LLM finds the characters and marks who speaks each line; check and fix it in the markup editor, give every character a voice.
A voice from a video or a long recording: Folivox finds clean 6–15 s stretches, shows their text and lets you pick one (studio and `voices add`).
Adding a voice checks the recognised text and warns when it does not fit the recording or is in another script than the sample language.
The recommended sample length follows the engine (CosyVoice 6–15 s, Fish 10–30 s).
Fish install in the studio shows live status, speed and time left; the download total is no longer stuck at 100%.
Markup editor: an online engine can be used to listen to a sample; the list names its model and says it is paid.
Language detection tells about 30 Latin-script languages apart and recognises Persian and Urdu; sentences are split on the punctuation of every script.
Chinese ordinal floors read correctly (第2层 → 第二层).
Fish Audio engines: the studio picks the build automatically by total memory; build names show their size.
Version and change history in the studio footer.
Crashes in the FB2/EPUB/PDF readers and in number normalisation on unusual input.
Studio jobs that could get stuck after a crashed render; leftover ffmpeg temporary files are cleaned up.
Broken config.toml values no longer stop the app from starting.
Native C++ runtime (audio.cpp) for CosyVoice 3 and the Fish engines (S2 Pro, Drama 3): faster, lighter on memory.
Books with several languages: language shares per book and per speaker, each fragment is read with its own language rules.
Editor: listen to a sample with progress on the button; a rendered sample is kept until the text, markup, voices or engine change.
Reuse of model weights already on this computer (Hugging Face cache, LM Studio), checked by sha256.
Engine install progress is honest, and the studio joins an install that is already running.
